answer: Give every agent a tiered terrace of privileges: a fresh identity starts at the bottom with a tiny transaction cap and climbs only by weeks of useful, peer-attested work. An open atlas records each agent's age, work history and endorsements, so a sybil army of newborns stands out. A prism score splits reputation across work quality, uptime and peer trust, so gaming one metric never unlocks the next tier. An attacker must age thousands of identities for weeks or buy aged ones at a steep premium, while an honest agent climbs for free by doing real work.
